requirements.procedure: P1 requires an isolated unique campaign; authenticate the original bundle and bind local bundle path/hash; parse and recursively enumerate six payloads and nested executable images; validate spans/checksums; preserve reversible package->payload->loaded-address maps per address space; reconcile reuse by exact input hashes/tools/ranges/file presence; initial byte ledger and architecture analysis plan. G1 requires whole bundle and payload hashes, all container spans accounted, every nested image explicitly mapped, initial byte ledger and architecture-specific plan. Unknown code/data may remain if explicitly classified. No C task decomposition.

v2_files.identity.json: campaign/target/target-lock identity, bundle and exactly six payload identities, outer-container validation receipt, and authenticated review-registry reference
v2_files.inventory/images.jsonl: schema 2 rows with campaign/id; parent-first image hierarchy; source span and full parent hash; decoded size/hash/path; transform; resolved mapping or reviewed mapping_model; architecture, address spaces, accounting review
v2_files.inventory/coverage.jsonl: package and each payload complete interval partitions plus per-image shadow partitions; evidence path/hash/input hash and review ID
v2_files.inventory/reviews.jsonl: canonical record hashes, distinct author/reviewer, decision, actual-file-checked input hashes, registry-authenticated review receipt
v2_files.inventory/analysis-plan.json: one architecture/endianness/mode/address-space/decoder-support plan per payload, hash-bound evidence and independent review
v2_files.inventory/discovery-reconciliation.jsonl: exactly six payload records, enumerating all image IDs with evidence bound to payload hashes and independent review
v2_files.receipts/: actual command/tool/config/script/input/output hashes, exit status, time and scope; transform receipts additionally bind exact source slice, output, toolchain and review basis

requirements.v2_gate_limits: Validator checks internal consistency and reviewed/hash-bound records, not whether discovery is truly exhaustive, decompiler is correct, or the G2 corpus is complete. A registry hash supplied on CLI is an out-of-band trust input. Passing v2 alone is not an independent G1 gate decision.

safe_inventory_construction: Create fresh canonical inventory outputs only under this campaign's inventory/ and private attempt directories; use temporary files plus atomic rename, preserving every existing candidate, receipt, authenticated evidence file, and working-tree change.

Treat *-reuse-candidates as leads. For each proposed reuse, compare exact payload/image input hashes, ranges, parser/tool/script/config hashes, review inputs and current file presence; regenerate/review when any dependency is stale. Do not copy a historical pass label or silently fill missing coverage with unknown intervals without evidence and independent review.

Derive package/payload/image bytes and maps from the already authenticated read-only bundle/payloads; verify container checksum/bounds facts and each child span. Keep package offsets distinct from payload offsets and loaded addresses. Preserve the existing identity and outer-container receipt byte-for-byte unless they are proven inaccurate; record a new corrected parser receipt as a separate attempt if required.

Use new campaign-specific review records and coordinator-authenticated registry. Obtain the registry hash through the trusted/out-of-band process and pass it to v2; do not self-authenticate by merely hashing an untrusted registry. Leave old evidence in place and record stale refs as excluded or superseded.

Run schema-v2 validator after all required records and reviews exist; separately inspect validator weaknesses and independently reconcile completeness/byte denominators before any G1 claim. Keep status.json at not_run until evidence-based gate review is actually completed.
validator_weak_checks: validate_campaign.py validates minimal identity fields and then relies on a hard-coded subset of legacy files; it lacks v2 image hierarchy, mappings, input-bound reviews, discovery, checksums and nested-image accounting checks.
validate_inventory_v2.py explicitly cannot prove exhaustive discovery or decoder correctness; review IDs and registry authenticity depend on an external trusted hash/registry process.

Inventory consistency is not sufficient to prove all physical bytes were found: discovery reconciliation is a reviewed assertion. Independently inspect container parsing, checksums, mapping arithmetic, interval denominators, and provenance for each executable span.
